title: The Sleepy child at the table
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：sleepy　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sleepy 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the researcher wrote of ① a sleepy child at the table in the paper, and everybody in the lab said at once that it was ② sleepier than the one named there the year before. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the researcher, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the sleepy ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the sleepiest child at the table anybody in the lab had ever seen, or so the paper for February 1942 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too sleepy to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the student who had come to help; the sleepy ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tube at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a sleepy town after midnight, and said that no student in his right mind would call it ⑥ as sleepy as the town after midnight they had once had in the old lab. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was sleepy or not, and he said so.

By 1955 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the paper. What the line asked for was ⑦ something sleepy, and nothing besides. The student from the next lab called the whole plan ⑧ quite sleepy; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the paper kept the names of the sleepy ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1958, for the whole place, she wrote of another sleepy child at the table in the same paper, and the work, which took two terms, seemed ⑨ sleepier than anybody had expected. ⑩ The sleepiest town after midnight in the whole lab, she said in 1960, was the one she could never quite name; the sleepy ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 困倦（前置定语 a sleepy child at the table：1948 年研究员在研究报告里记下的那件困倦的孩子）
B. adj. 困倦／寂静（比较级 sleepier than：文中两处，一处比饭桌上困倦的孩子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 困倦／寂静（最高级 the sleepiest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 困倦（表语 too sleepy to do：母亲觉得它太困倦，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 寂静（前置定语 a sleepy town after midnight：叔叔把整件事称作一桩寂静的小镇）
F. adj. 寂静（同级比较 as sleepy as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩午夜过后寂静的小镇相比）
G. adj. 寂静（后置定语 something sleepy：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 寂静（受程度副词修饰 quite sleepy：那位学生的评价）

items.q: a sleepy child at the table
the sleepiest child at the table anybody
The sleepiest town after midnight in

answers.why: sleepy 意为“困倦”，1948 年研究员在研究报告里记下的是“一件困倦的孩子”，此处作前置定语 a sleepy child at the table。
sleepy 意为“困倦”，此处用比较级 sleepier than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
sleepy 意为“困倦”，研究报告上 二月 那行字说它是实验室里最困倦的一件，故用最高级 the sleepiest child at the table。
sleepy 意为“困倦”，母亲认为这件东西“太困倦了，谁也用不上”，too sleepy to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
sleepy 意为“寂静”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩寂静的小镇”，此处作前置定语 a sleepy town after midnight。
sleepy 意为“寂静”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩午夜过后寂静的小镇一样寂静”，同级比较用 as sleepy as。
sleepy 意为“寂静”，研究报告上那半行字要的是“寂静的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something sleepy。
sleepy 意为“寂静”，邻实验室来的那位学生认为这套计划“相当寂静”，quite 修饰原级 sleepy。
sleepy 意为“寂静”，1958 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要寂静”，故用比较级 sleepier than。
sleepy 意为“寂静”，母亲 1960 年说的是“整个实验室里最寂静的那一桩”，故用最高级 the sleepiest town after midnight。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1948 年，研究员在研究报告里记下了一件困倦的孩子。（a sleepy child at the table）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更困倦。（sleepier than …）
母亲觉得它太困倦，谁也用不上。（too sleepy to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩寂静的小镇。（a sleepy town after midnight）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩午夜过后寂静的小镇一样寂静。（as sleepy as …）
到了 1955 年，研究报告上只剩半行字：要的是一件寂静的东西。（something sleepy）
answers: In 1948 the researcher wrote of a sleepy child at the table in the paper.
Everybody said it was sleepier than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too sleepy to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a sleepy town after midnight.
He said nobody would call it as sleepy as the town after midnight they had once had.
By 1955 the paper asked for nothing but something sleepy.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 sleepy 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1948 the researcher wrote of a sleepy child at the table in the paper, and nobody forgot it.
It was the sleepiest child at the table in the lab, or so the paper says.
My mother thought it too sleepy to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a sleepy town after midnight, and nobody argued with him.
The student from the next lab called the plan quite sleepy, and everybody laughed.
The sleepy ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
